The closest thing the Dark Side has to an [[Endor Shield]] at the moment. You wanna slow the infiltratiojn of those Rebels? Tghen this is your card. Lose 1 Force each time they deploy a Rebel, vehicle or starship to [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] is nasty. Stop that card form moving or battling this turn also prevents a LOT of surprises!

But remember - you gotta keep control of the Bunker to make this work. Beware the Rebel strike force that deploys to the Bunker as only the first character is stopped by [[Perimeter Patrol]], while the others can now get inas normal.

Of course, thats what [[Closed Door]] is for. :)

Combo: = I hope you Rebels have a Landing site!

= and now the Empire is looking incontrol of [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]]. You wan to deploy [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] With Heavy [[Blaster]] to [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]]? Pay 8, lose 1 Force and don't move or battle this turn.
